originalRunnerFinding: wait/log exceptions or SIGTERM/KeyboardInterrupt could bypass group cleanup/final receipt
repair: Active child try/finally closes only original owned group, waits/reaps direct child; handler records supported SIGTERM/SIGINT interruption as unqualified; bounded cleanup shields repeat signals; outer finally emits original partial commands, interruption/first failure, remaining UNRUN and final groups/FD/source receipt; supported launch signals are deferred until Popen ownership is captured without passing blocked/ignored signals to the child
limitations: No protection against uncatchable SIGKILL or inability to write the entire filesystem; no invented interruption runtime proof.
